feeds.title: Drap-Art
feeds.description: Founded in 1995 by a collective of artists and cultural enthusiasts, Drap-Art emerged as a beacon of eco-conscious creativity in Barcelona. Through festivals, exhibitions, and workshops, they amplify the message of sustainability and resourcefulness, challenging societal norms and fostering dialogue on environmental and social issues. Drap-Art's mission resonates through its commitment to art as a catalyst for change and awareness.

feeds.title: FrikiFish
feeds.description: FrikiFish, helmed by local artist Amelia Johannsen, blossoms into an online haven for creative exploration. With a diverse array of articles spanning various art forms, from design to street art, it celebrates emerging talent and cultural vibrancy in and around Barcelona.

feeds.title: Museu Europeu d'Art Modern
feeds.description: The Museu Europeu d'Art Modern stands as a pioneering institution, showcasing contemporary figurative artists globally. As the first living museum of its kind, it champions painting and sculpture, fostering a dynamic platform for artistic expression.

feeds.title: Peter Freund Blog
feeds.description: Peter Freund, a versatile artist, often toggles between writing and art to fuel his creative endeavours. Co-founder of Adversorecto, he explores the concept of 'retraction,' utilizing appropriation to challenge historical narratives. His work, characterized by algorithmic reduction, navigates the intersection of memory and enigma, forging innovative paths in contemporary art.

feeds.title: Badabadoc Art Blog
feeds.description: Nuria and Javi extend a warm welcome to Badabadoc Art, a realm brimming with creativity and passion. As ardent aficionados of handmade crafts and DIY, they transform dreams into reality. Their store, backed by a dedicated team, offers personalized service, ensuring a seamless experience for every customer.

feeds.title: Fundació Antoni Tàpies Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1984 by artist Antoni Tàpies, the Foundation aims to illuminate modern and contemporary art through exhibitions and cultural endeavours. With a pluralistic approach, it invites all to engage with its diverse offerings and fosters a sense of belonging. The Foundation provides tailored visits and workshops, ensuring accessibility and inclusivity in its mission to enrich artistic understanding and appreciation.

feeds.title: Street Art Barcelona Blog
feeds.description: Street Art Barcelona (SAB), a collaborative platform, championed Barcelona's urban art scene since 2011. Comprising artists, curators, and entrepreneurs, SAB transforms the city into a vibrant outdoor gallery. Their mission: redefining Barcelona's essence through quality events and shared experiences, inviting all to perceive the city anew.

feeds.title: Setdart Subastas
feeds.description: Setdart emerged in 2004, revolutionizing the art auction landscape with a modern ethos. Its mission: elevate Spanish art globally, democratize art collecting, and provide expert guidance. With offices in key Spanish cities, it blends physical presence with online accessibility, fostering inclusivity. Setdart's diverse offerings and expert team have democratized art ownership, facilitating notable acquisitions by top museums and collectors worldwide.

feeds.title: Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona
feeds.description: The Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona is a beacon of contemporary artistic expression, fostering diverse perspectives and inciting critical discourse. With a mission to ignite passion and curiosity for modern art, MACBA aspires to catalyze societal transformation through immersive experiences and thought-provoking dialogue, shaping a more enlightened and culturally enriched community.

feeds.title: Museo Europeo de Arte Moderno
feeds.description: The Museo Europeo de Arte Moderno pulsates with life, a dynamic sanctuary where art transcends boundaries. From captivating exhibitions to immersive workshops and performances, it offers a holistic experience. Join the MEAM journey to elevate Figurative Art Contemporary, shaping a future where creativity thrives.

feeds.title: ArtsLibris
feeds.description: Rocío SC Santa Cruz, founder of ArtsLibris, brings a wealth of experience from École Estienne in Paris. With the Raíña Lupa publishing label established in 1994 and later relocated to Barcelona, she spearheads innovative projects. The ArtsLibris team, adaptable and diverse, comprises professionals passionate about artist publications and photobooks, ensuring a multifaceted approach to their events.

feeds.title: Metàfora Studio Arts Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1999 by Jette Bjerg and Carles Ramos, Metàfora emerges as a beacon of creativity and learning. Drawing from their diverse artistic backgrounds, they establish Metàfora as a dynamic space for studio arts and art therapy. Supported by a dedicated team, they prioritize quality education and individualized student care, cultivating a nurturing environment for artistic exploration and growth.

feeds.title: 137º Ceramic Art Studio Blog
feeds.description: 137º Ceramic Art Studio, a hub for artistic ceramics in Barcelona, hosts personalized events alongside scheduled classes. Through their blog, they foster community engagement, sharing insights on exhibitions, artist residencies, and global ceramic trends. Committed to nurturing creativity, they showcase their own artistic endeavors while promoting ceramic art's values and processes.

feeds.title: Grey Street Blog
feeds.description: Grey Street, nestled in Barcelona's Raval district, is a charming sweet store curated by Amy since June 13, 2012. Named after her grandparents' street in Canberra, Australia, it blossoms into a haven for local and international artists and brands. Embracing a shop-small ethos, Grey Street champions sustainability while offering a delightful array of treats and treasures.

feeds.title: The Art Büro Blog
feeds.description: The Art Büro, a boutique art consultancy, curates bespoke artwork for homes, offices, and commercial ventures. Specializing in contemporary Spanish art, they offer personalized guidance to clients, designers, and developers. Their blog shares insights and discoveries, embodying a commitment to navigating the local art scene and enhancing aesthetic journeys for all.

feeds.title: Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya Blog
feeds.description: The Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya's blog, published Thursdays, unveils the museum's inner workings and enriching insights. Delving into exhibition setups, collection highlights, and team perspectives, it offers a multifaceted view of museum life. With a collective voice, it shares diverse experiences and knowledge, fostering engagement and appreciation among readers.

feeds.title: Àngels Canut Blog
feeds.description: Àngels Canut, with a DEA from the University of Barcelona, is a seasoned researcher in Art History, specializing in jewellery and antiques. Her career spans curation, documentation, and exhibition management. At her workshop, she crafts bespoke jewellery pieces and limited editions, integrating semiprecious stones, reflecting her dedication to artisanal craftsmanship and unique design.

feeds.title: Jordi Freixas Cortés Blog
feeds.description: Jordi Freixas Cortés, the Catalan impressionist luminary of the 'lost generation,' found solace and purpose in art amid illness, guided by his doctor-uncle's advice. Evolving through the School of Fine Arts and collaborations with luminaries like Joan Llaveries, his style matured gracefully. Tragically, he departed peacefully in slumber at the cusp of his zenith, leaving behind a legacy of unmatched creativity and promise.
